editorialReview.historicalPayloadProof: Restoring only the exact documented field corrections and retirement flags reproduces the full prior published release digest.

similarityScreen.limits: TF-IDF thresholds prioritize editorial review; they do not prove absence of every semantic overlap. A repeated vignette in a deliberate linked set tests separate decisions and is labelled as a follow-up.

frozenSourceConsistency.limits: Verifies the preserved authoring baseline against official cached XML. Runtime clinical corrections are deliberately different and separately traced in repetition-corrections.json. Matching a source is not proof that the source claim is clinically correct.

selectionReview.quickPractice: New unassigned case families, one item per situation. Previous unfinished sessions reserve their situations too. No automatic backfill.
selectionReview.customPractice: New by default; displayed counts use the selection function. Explicit follow-ups permit other unassigned objectives in familiar cases; All permits revisits.
selectionReview.diagnostic: Six new distinct situations per NP, or no partial diagnostic.
selectionReview.mock: Fixed 100-item selections keep whole linked situations and label follow-up items.
selectionReview.missedAndVault: Explicit retries preserve their intended review behavior.
selectionReview.flashcards: Due first, one card per case per queue; fresh cases before unseen follow-ups. Identical custom front/back pairs appear once without deleting saved cards.
selectionReview.topics: Legacy mappings use immutable case IDs, not offsets in the filtered active question array.

verification.protectedBackendPayload: all 10,652 records and 120 historical case records match the reviewed bank
verification.backendIsolation: anonymous and unclaimed reads denied; separate QA profiles cannot read or write each other’s progress

localBrowser.topicQuickSet: Five different situations; after assignment the same topic has zero new distinct cases and 24 unassigned follow-up questions.
localBrowser.answerReview: Mobile incorrect-answer grading and all three alternative explanations with reference links verified.

limits: Full-bank structural checks and targeted editorial/source review do not establish independent nursing-educator approval or guarantee absence of every clinical error or semantic overlap.
